manual_repair_rationale: The final manual repair keeps the direct output-pointer check signal (`if (!fw)`) but suppresses follow-on member-access branch conditions such as `fw->size`, which are reachable after the fixed-version `ret = request_firmware(...)` / `if (ret) return` barrier. This preserves a buggy-side patch semantic alert while removing the fixed-side false positive.
validation_basis: Rebuilt SAGenTestPlugin with Knighter LLVM and reran strict patch-local validation for sound/soc/codecs/sma1307.o on buggy and fixed versions.
